title: Design characters and scenery with your campaign companion

features.title: One conversation from idea to character
features.description: Keep chatting or talking as you develop the brief, choose visual concepts, prepare a Meshy model and build a printable character sheet or compact card. Online generation requires your own working provider keys.

features.title: Your reusable character and scenery libraries
features.description: Create or continue characters and named scenery packs from the workshop. Import STL, OBJ, GLB, 3MF or ZIP packs, then place saved models into your worlds and encounters.

features.title: Approve concepts, keep your work and back it up
features.description: Retain the concepts you like and approve a reference before submitting it to Meshy. Export local asset backups or smaller reference backups. Generated geometry still needs thickness, slicing and connector review before printing.
